content:
With the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolling out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here's the latest.

The new chat bubbles look more rounded

Several months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and fine-tuning the new look with TestFlight and select users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubble design is starting to roll out to some users on the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo has to say:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more uniform.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to some users on the WhatsApp TestFlight build. There's no word yet on when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users.
